verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a bulk-operation capability, such as multi-select actions across chats, files, memories, users or models. Nearby features do not qualify: parallel sub-agents and per-worktree agents are task delegation, Automations are recurring scheduled prompts rather than batch actions over many items, and API keys and Python Functions are only developer building blocks for scripting such operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
